title: Tiny Woman World 솔로 #137 · 소인 여성 × 주방 대리석 딸기 · 교복 · 교복(마이크로 비키니 탑 × 마이크로 비키니 + 교복 파이핑 · modal jersey) · hourglass bombshell · 서기 · 배경 주방 대리석 딸기 · 걸크러시
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm caramel complexion, late 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, wolf cut ash brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school uniform set, a micro bikini top of two tiny triangle cups of ultra-thin matte crisp white modal jersey with thin navy piping, held by thin navy strings tied behind her neck and back, with a small gold crest bead between the cups, her shoulders, arms and midriff bare, and a micro pleated skirt of ultra-thin matte pale-blue modal jersey with a thin navy stripe along the hem, sitting at the top of her hip bones with a plain ultra-high slit up the right side from the hem to her hip bone, with the hem ending just below her hip bones. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, faint freckles on her chest V and the backs of her hands and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin modal jersey molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the soft matte drape of the white modal jersey against her bare shoulders and the crisp pleats of the skirt, fine stretch lines and a soft powdery matte finish. Pose: standing on the marble with her weight on one leg and the other leg crossed in front, one hand resting on her outer hip and the other arm hanging relaxed at her side, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, thigh-high platform stiletto boots made of glossy pale blue leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in pale blue lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows satin skin finish, smooth silky sheen.

Background: a white marble kitchen counter in a macro world where everyday objects are enormous: gigantic red strawberries each as big as a boulder, a giant porcelain teacup with rising steam, a mountain of whipped cream, a giant silver spoon lying across the marble, a softly blurred sunny window far behind; she is a tiny woman only six inches tall walking across the marble between the giant strawberries with the giant objects rising far above her head, the whole scene clearly visible and in focus, lit by bright morning sunlight with soft shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a close distance with the camera at her eye level, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the enormous strawberries, teacup and whipped cream around her at their true giant scale so her tiny size and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
